title: Joomla! Core - [20261154] - Core - Improper ACL checks in com_workflow stages in Joomla 4.0.0-5.4.10, 6.0.0-6.2.0 -…
description: Joomla! Core - [20261154] - Core - Improper ACL checks in com_workflow stages in Joomla 4.0.0-5.4.10, 6.0.0-6.2.0 - Permission checks for workflow stages used a wrong asset name, so stage specific permissions were ignored when changing the state of or deleting a stage.
